platform: ar-lens (SPECS, Lens Studio preview, judged as 1280x720 video); web and video surfaces carry the same kit
metaphor: the clave written on the floor: the pad is the clave's grid, each footprint a struck note, light the strike decaying like hardwood, holds as rests
home_polarity: the world (additive display, black is nothing); dark on web and video
category_convention_avoided: salsa apps: black or deep red with hot pink or magenta, brush-script type with exclamation marks, a couple's silhouette mid-dip, neon glow; AR footprint apps: flat white or yellow shoe outlines with numerals floating beside them; the footwork diagram: peach and light-blue foot blobs with numerals inside; Specs Lenses: SnapOS frosted dark rounded panels with white text and purple selection, hovering at eye level
design_code: Everything drawn is light that strikes on the count and decays like a struck hardwood, because the display is additive and the clave is salsa's timekeeper; so nothing fades in for feel and nothing sits at full brightness except the current count

Ivory is the only ink and brightness is the only hierarchy, with teal reserved for the 1, because alpha is brightness on an additive display and finding the 1 is the whole job of an On1 dancer; so no second accent, no semantic colour set, no colour-coded feet

Left feet are solid and right feet are outlined, because the clave is one pair with two roles (one is held in the cupped hand, the other strikes it) and a foot must read mid-turn in a compressed video; so no peach-and-blue blobs

The pad is a bordered parquet square on the real floor and the only panel is a strip of text at hip height with two capsule targets, because the class floor is a portable square with an edge and the event's named failure is a website floating in front of your face; so no frosted panel, no icon rows, no settings

axes.canvas: the world; faint parquet grain on the pad
axes.chroma_budget: mono+1 (ivory at three brightnesses, teal on the 1 only)
axes.type_voice: hyperlegible humanist sans, one family, heaviest weight for numerals
axes.structure: canvas-spatial: the pad on the floor, the strip and numeral above its far edge, the step card to the right at hip height
axes.edge: capsule: rounded ends like the claves; 4 cm pad corners; sole-print toes are the only points
axes.depth: light-only: nothing is above anything, no shadows, no halos
axes.ornament: motion (the strike and its decay); texture second (parquet grain at 12%)
axes.motion: functional-only: rise a step on the and, strike on the count, decay over one beat; two-count fade between steps; nothing else
axes.numerals: tabular, one per cell, ExtraBold; holds shown as empty cells, never as dimmed numerals

tokens.strike_role: the ink: the current count at 100% alpha, all text, outlines and the pad border
tokens.and_role: the half-beat rise before a count
tokens.uno_role: the 1 only: the count-1 cell and the footprint that lands on 1
tokens.uno_on_ivory_role: the 1 on ivory grounds (the Devpost page's light surfaces, the dark-ink wordmark): the eyedrop itself, unlifted
tokens.uno_source: ceiling wash in baile-de-salsa-2.jpg (#4486b2) lifted to emissive lightness, hue kept
tokens.grain: #F7EEDF at 12% alpha, basket-weave parquet tile 30 cm
tokens.panel: #F7EEDF at 30% alpha, capsule behind the two buttons only
tokens.floor_role: ground for the icon, the video title card and the Devpost page; never used inside the Lens
tokens.type_display: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next ExtraBold (800), the only weight inside the Lens
tokens.type_body: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Medium (500), for long text on a page; not used in the Lens (it washed out against bright rooms in the preview)
tokens.radius: capsule (half the height) on cells and buttons; 4 cm on the pad
tokens.motion_easing: decay: exponential, brightness = rest + (strike - rest) * exp(-4 t) over one beat; rise and fade: linear

as_built.note: What the Lens ships with where it differs from the tokens above, each change measured in the preview and recorded in devpost/design-pass-report.md. The source of truth for the Lens is Assets/Scripts/FloorcountLook.ts.
as_built.strip_reason: at 6 x 3 cm a cell was about 20 px wide in a 720p frame of the whole pad and the strip read as a dotted line
as_built.card_reason: the brand-sheet scale put 'Basic step' at 53 cm wide, wider than the glasses show at 1 m, and a 10 cm label cannot sit on a 5 cm capsule
as_built.outline_reason: the thinner strokes smeared in compressed 720p video
as_built.arrow_rule: shown only while neither the pad nor the step card is within 24 degrees of the view axis
as_built.answers: one Again or Got it per 8-count, none before the first 8-count has played

critique: Brand sheet: nine render rounds on 2026-11-02, blind critic from round 2; scores 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 3, 4 (round 7 had a layout fault fixed in round 8). What the critic kept naming by the end was the brand-sheet form itself, not the brand; the wordmark's teal o, the empty-cell holds in the type specimen and the count band were named as the work of a point of view in every round. The Lens surface is critiqued separately after the design pass.
notes: Hackathon Lens (Learn AR with SPECS). The accent is the hall's ceiling wash from the class photo; every warm hue was refused because Eyes Up (same canvas, same spatial structure) holds orange and Final Buzzer holds gold. The brief's (default) values this manifest changes: footprint colours (was blue left, orange right) and the count display (now the clave strip plus the numeral). Everything else in the brief stands.
